blind.description: A stylized fantasy/cartoon two-tiered wooden storage rack loaded with dark metallic ingots. The rack consists of four thick vertical corner posts with visible wooden pegs and mortise-tenon crossbeams framing two shelves. The top shelf holds several long dark grey/bronze metallic bars arranged neatly, while the bottom shelf holds a row of smaller ingots. All geometry is solid, watertight, and cleanly modeled in a chunky stylized art style with hand-painted wood and matte metal textures. The four legs sit flat on the ground.
blind.from_above: A rectangular view showing four corner square wooden post heads, the wooden side rails, and a central filling of rectangular dark metal bars neatly stacked in parallel rows.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 2.5 feet tall (around knee-to-thigh height of the 5 ft 9 in figure) and about 3.5 to 4 feet wide.
